capabilities: Hide selected toolbar buttons per .base file
Read hide rules from a toolbar.hide block in .base YAML
Apply per-embed hide directives through the embed alias
Pin views as custom toolbar buttons with icons or labels
Reorder custom buttons by drag and drop
disambiguation: Not a general ribbon or editor toolbar customizer; it only changes toolbars inside Bases files and their embeds.
extras: Not yet published in the community plugin list; requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer. Inline ```base code blocks are not affected because they are not tied to a .base file.
intentEvidence: Configure which toolbar buttons are visible in Obsidian Bases — both in standalone .base files and in embedded bases
problem: Bases toolbars show the same buttons everywhere, with no way to hide unused ones or pin frequently used views per file.
summary: Plugin that hides chosen toolbar buttons in Obsidian Bases files and embeds and adds custom view-switcher buttons.
